description: This file implements a specialized storage reader for quantized tensors within the PyTorch distributed checkpointing framework, extending functionality to handle dequantization of quantized models, especially with MXFP4 format. It includes methods for metadata processing, reading quantized tensors, dequantization logic, and handling block-aligned slices.

classes.name: QuantizedHuggingFaceStorageReader
classes.description: Extension of HuggingFaceStorageReader that handles dequantization of quantized tensors, including MXFP4 format, with methods for reading metadata, dequantizing tensors, and managing quantization specifics.
